title: TikTok Promotion Codes: What Actually Works, What Gets Withheld, and How to Stack Them
summary: Cut through stale coupon lists. See how TikTok promotion codes really work, which Reddit codes hold up, why some get withheld, and how to stack first-order codes for the biggest discount.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### How do I enter a TikTok rewards code at checkout?


TikTok promotion codes are entered in the coupon or promotion field on the TikTok Shop checkout screen. Add an eligible item to your cart, proceed to checkout, enter the code exactly as provided, and apply it. Confirm the discount appears in your order total before submitting payment.


### Where can I find valid TikTok promotion codes?


Start with TikTok Shop's Coupon Center, product listings, seller pages, and email promotions from sellers or the platform. Livestreams and creator videos can surface limited offers tied to featured products. Aggregator lists from sites like RetailMeNot or Groupon provide leads, but checkout always determines eligibility.


### Why is my TikTok promo code not working?


A rejected TikTok promo code usually signals an eligibility mismatch rather than a simple expiration. Check whether your account qualifies, whether your cart meets the minimum spend, whether the product is sold by the eligible shop, and whether the promotion period is still active. Swap in one eligible item to test before building a full cart.


### How do I get free promos or coupons on TikTok Shop?


Claim platform coupons from TikTok Shop's Coupon Center, seller coupons attached to qualifying products, and creator-distributed codes from videos or livestreams. Read the on-screen terms before assuming a code applies across an entire shop. Eligibility varies by account, seller, product, and promotion period.


### What is the difference between platform coupons, seller coupons, and creator codes on TikTok?


Platform coupons come from TikTok Shop with platform-defined terms and apply to eligible listings. Seller coupons apply only to qualifying items from the issuing shop, and creator codes are tied to the specific product or seller featured in a creator's promotion. Matching the code type to your cart is essential.


### Do Reddit TikTok codes like Get100 and Slash99 actually work?


Reddit codes like Get100 and dailycoupon100 are user reports, not guaranteed offers. Shoppers describe Get100 being withheld after earlier use, and commenters call Slash99 not worth it. Treat community posts as leads, check the original post date, and test the code against your own account and eligible item.


### Can I trust coupon aggregator sites for TikTok Shop codes?


Aggregator sites like CouponFollow, Groupon, and RetailMeNot list dated snapshots of offers, not live guarantees. These listings help you find leads, but TikTok Shop's offer terms and your checkout determine actual eligibility. Always confirm the discount appears in your order total before relying on an aggregated code.
